sentences.en: The band played marvellously under the baton of a new conductor.
sentences.zh: 在这位新指挥的带领下，乐队演奏得非常出色。

sentences.en: Judging from his appearance, he must be the conductor.
sentences.zh: 从他的外表来看，他一定是售票员。

sentences.en: He stands alone as a conductor of ballet music.
sentences.zh: 作为芭蕾舞音乐的指挥，他是独一无二的。

senses.zh: （乐队等的）指挥；售票员，检票员；导体；<英>传导教育的引导者
